original_test_intent: Validate a fully populated server through 1000 AC off/on cycles within the defined campaign without boot, inventory or log regression.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Use the approved AC-cycle fixture/controller and validate each cycle.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: All required cycles complete with the platform recoverable, complete inventory and no disallowed errors.

historical_reviews.v3: RECLASSIFIED from manual to hybrid REQUIRES because an approved programmable PDU can automate the campaign after operator setup.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Qualified operator installs and inspects fixture/interlocks; PA Manager existing Cycle function should own the approved loop.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: 1000 AC cycles and original campaign timing are preserved.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Approved cycle count/window, off/on/boot-ready timing, inventory and stop policy.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: An approved 100-cycle project run may be complete for that project but leaves 900 Master-default cycles uncovered.

original_method: Use the qualified AC fixture and existing PA Manager/project cycle controller; do not create a competing loop.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Configure the approved PA Manager Cycle or project cycle script with immutable per-cycle evidence.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project-qualified cycle-tool SOP and hardware fixture documentation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Approved count/timing differences are explicit overrides.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: AC switching, boot failure and evidence loss require hard stops and OOB recovery.

safety_boundaries: No AC action before target/interlock verification
No hidden retry or count reset
Stop on loss of control or hardware/data risk
no_automatic_retry: Failed cycles remain failed; the next pre-approved loop is not a retry.
engineer_owned_verdict: Agent records project completion and Master coverage gap; engineer decides result.
review_improvement: V3.1 adds the explicit project-override accounting and existing PA Manager Cycle priority without changing the hybrid capability or safety gates.
